name: Needy
overview: Scripture calls believers to compassionate action toward the needy, urging them not to harden their hearts or withhold help from their poor brothers (Deuteronomy 15:7). God Himself is described as a refuge and strength to those in distress, promising protection and justice for the afflicted and needy (Isaiah 25:4; Psalms 82:3). Giving to the poor is portrayed as lending to the Lord, who will repay such deeds, and believers are encouraged to store up eternal treasures by generously providing for others (Proverbs 19:17; Luke 12:33). God's response to the sighing of the needy assures His intervention and safety for those oppressed (Psalms 12:5).
